caption:
The dua no one else hears

Allah tells us to call upon Him with humility and in private. Tonight, before sleep, talk to Him quietly about what you carry.

Surah Al-A'raaf 7:55

Find two quiet minutes tonight and make your own dua

#dua #nightdua #privatedua #quranreels

Recitation: Mishary Alafasy
